name: Taking Care Of Elderly Parents
overview: Scripture commands believers to honor and respect their elderly parents as a sacred duty, promising blessings for those who do so, as seen in Exodus 20:12 and Matthew 15:4. The Old Testament highlights the dignity of old age, describing the gray head as a crown of glory and a mark of righteousness (Proverbs 16:31, 20:29), while Leviticus 19:32 calls for rising before the elderly and honoring them out of reverence for God. This teaching underscores the importance of caring for aging parents with respect and love, recognizing their God-given value even in their later years.
